layers.name: Supporting line
layers.customText: Wherever you are, lift your heart to *God*.

layers.name: Supporting line
layers.customText: Welcome! We're happy to have you with us.

layers.name: Verse
layers.customText: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore *my heart greatly rejoiceth*; and with my song will I praise him.

layers.name: Supporting line
layers.customText: Our prayer team would love to pray with you. Find us at the front after the service.

layers.name: Supporting line
layers.customText: Find your seat, quiet your heart, and get ready to worship.

layers.name: Line under it
layers.customText: We are glad you are here
